description: Five public-interface guard gates: max/min/dropZeros and two literal-False controls. Required expectations define the acceptance obligations; revision-specific receipts establish passes. Max and dropZeros retain the original E8 finite search contracts; min uses a companion contract on the same inputs. Reference definitions and all universal post-checks are withheld from synthesis. The public dropZeros gate allows the existing generic List.filter/List.filterMap providers. Separate Lean fixtures test provider-free conditional recursion; this manifest alone does not establish that capability.
acceptance_notes: Build the current executable before using tools/run_extended.py with this manifest. Validate reference types, finite observations, and reference_proof scripts in the separate --validate-fixtures process.

A positive case passes only after the public result alias is available at its exact requested type, the universal kernel_checks example elaborates without sorry, and every held-out executable observation is true.

The universal maximum/minimum checks introduce arbitrary naturals, split the native Decidable order evidence, unfold the actual result alias, and simplify each branch. They do not invoke decide on an infinite universal proposition.

The universal dropZeros check performs induction on an arbitrary list, splits the head's zero-test evidence, bridges Boolean inequality to propositional inequality, unfolds the result alias, and uses the induction hypothesis. A future candidate with different reduction behavior may need an explicitly reviewed proof adjustment; the universal proposition must be retained.
The only uses of by decide generated by reference validation concern the explicitly finite concrete search/replay observations. Every universal reference proof is supplied explicitly.
A bounded search miss, replay error, unexpected diagnostic, nonzero exit, or stderr is failure. Each False control requires a certified contract-impossible outcome, not silence or timeout.

Denominator: 5 public gates. Provider-restricted construction is tested separately and contributes no extra cases to this manifest. This denominator is not a verified score. Public filter reuse must not be reported as evidence of filter-withheld recursive synthesis.

cases.title: Maximum from order guards with a universal extensional check

kernel_checks.type: ∀ a b : Nat, {f} a b = Nat.max a b
kernel_checks.proof: by intro a b; cases hd : (inferInstance : Decidable (a ≤ b)) <;> simp_all [{f}, Nat.max_def]

cases.source: docs/proposals/11-further-improvements/sections/01-evidence.tex probe 9; exact finite contract copied from tests/benchmarks/extended.json probe09_max; Lean v4.34.0 Init/Data/Nat/Basic.lean Nat.max_def

cases.title: Minimum selects the opposite order-guard branches

kernel_checks.type: ∀ a b : Nat, {f} a b = Nat.min a b
kernel_checks.proof: by intro a b; cases hd : (inferInstance : Decidable (a ≤ b)) <;> simp_all [{f}, Nat.min_def]

cases.source: New companion to article probe 9, using the same search inputs with minimum outputs; Lean v4.34.0 Init/Data/Nat/Basic.lean Nat.min_def

cases.title: Drop zero list elements through the public default provider set
cases.provider_scope: Default public inventory. The complete reference lambda is never introduced as a provider; generic List.filter and List.filterMap remain available. This case alone does not establish provider-free conditional recursion.

kernel_checks.type: ∀ xs : List Nat, {f} xs = List.filter (fun n => n != 0) xs
kernel_checks.proof: by intro xs; induction xs with | nil => rfl | cons n xs ih => cases hd : (inferInstance : Decidable (n = 0)) with | isFalse h => have hb : (n != 0) = true := bne_iff_ne.mpr h; simpa only [{f}, List.filter, hd, hb] using congrArg (List.cons n) ih | isTrue h => simp_all [{f}, List.filter]
